integrity: Universal statements are proved using Fourier moments, prime cyclotomic irreducibility and exact algebra; seven numerical prime cases are supportive checks only. Results are not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact prime-field triangle only; strictly positive real weights versus exactly rational weights. No exhaustive classification of real-positive four-node solutions, numerical perturbation bounds, or independent confirmation of bibliographic originality.
title: Four-node positive Fourier frames on a prime-field triangle and a sharp rational-weight gap
